body:
Directors can publish organisation prices through the existing pricing boundary. Existing installations receive the already-approved prices.publish.organisation grant through an additive migration. Other permission holders and staff-account authority remain unchanged; the main refresh retains BIL36 printing and BIL37 doctor read access.

Synthetic reference-only/rollback fixtures explicitly remove publish authority, preserving denial and rollback assertions. Positive tests cover ordinary Director pricing, catalogue import, consultation tariffs and linked medicine setup. Migration tests cover repeatability, missing roles and unchanged unrelated grants. The migration is byte-identical to the owner-approved artifact; rollback intentionally preserves grants. Sunday’s import operator remains Administrator.

Refreshed normally onto main 141418b067766512bfa57d1ff36391bb60aeff04. Nine of the eleven scoped blobs remain identical to the previous approved publication, including every test and the migration. The only permission-map conflict was resolved as the current main map plus the approved Director publication entry; TEAM retains both histories. Independent exact-head source review cleared eff0f716e51a8c57a3c8b1b731bc1d70bec50e85.

Validation: 73 focused PostgreSQL Feature tests / 1,556 assertions passed with a clean exit, including StaffAuthorityBoundaryTest and BIL36/BIL37 integration. Scoped Pint, PHPStan (0 errors), and diff checks pass. No frontend source changed in this refresh. Fresh exact-head CI and then-current-main ancestry remain required before the serial release turn. No production migration, deployment or real-data operation occurred.
